name: 테슬라 펌웨어 뉴스
tagline: Korean-language watch on Tesla's FSD rollouts: versions, builds, hardware splits.
description: Made for owners in Korea following the country's FSD rollout. It tracks which software version and build number is current, notes whether a release targets the HW3 or HW4 hardware generation, and reports in Korean. Word arrives only when something has actually moved, so a quiet stretch simply means nothing changed.
author: gbmksquare
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
